title: Structure and dynamics of SARS-CoV-2 proofreading exoribonuclease ExoN
authors: Moeller NH; Shi K; Demir Ö; Banerjee S; Yin L; Belica C; Durfee C; Amaro RE; Aihara H
one_liner_zh: 该文解析SARS-CoV-2 ExoN-nsp10复合物晶体结构并用MD模拟研究其RNA底物结合动态，属蛋白-RNA互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法可迁移但对象偏离TF-DNA核心。
abstract: High-fidelity replication of the large RNA genome of coronaviruses (CoVs) is mediated by a 3′-to-5′ exoribonuclease (ExoN) in non-structural protein 14 (nsp14), which excises nucleotides including antiviral drugs mis-incorporated by the low-fidelity viral RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp) and has also been implicated in viral RNA recombination and resistance to innate immunity. Here we determined a 1.6-Å resolution crystal structure of SARS-CoV-2 ExoN in complex with its essential co-factor, nsp10. The structure shows a highly basic and concave surface flanking the active site, comprising several Lys residues of nsp14 and the N-terminal amino group of nsp10. Modeling suggests that this basic patch binds to the template strand of double-stranded RNA substrates to position the 3′ end of the nascent strand in the ExoN active site, which is corroborated by mutational and computational analyses. Molecular dynamics simulations further show remarkable flexibility of multi-domain nsp14 and suggest that nsp10 stabilizes ExoN for substrate RNA-binding to support its exoribonuclease activity. Our high-resolution structure of the SARS-CoV-2 ExoN-nsp10 complex serves as a platform for future development of anti-coronaviral drugs or strategies to attenuate the viral virulence.
abstract_zh: 冠状病毒（CoVs）大RNA基因组的高保真复制由非结构蛋白14（nsp14）中的3′-至5′外切核糖核酸酶（ExoN）介导，该酶切除包括由低保真病毒RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶（RdRp）错误掺入的抗病毒药物在内的核苷酸，并也被涉及于病毒RNA重组和先天免疫抵抗。在此，我们确定了SARS-CoV-2 ExoN与其必需辅因子nsp10复合物的1.6-Å分辨率晶体结构。该结构显示一个高度碱性且凹形的表面，紧邻活性位点，包含nsp14的几个赖氨酸残基和nsp10的N端氨基。建模表明，该碱性斑块结合双链RNA底物的模板链，以将新生链的3′端定位在ExoN活性位点中，这一点通过突变和计算分析得到证实。分子动力学模拟进一步显示多结构域nsp14的显著灵活性，并提示nsp10稳定ExoN以支持底物RNA结合，从而维持其外切核糖核酸酶活性。我们高分辨率的SARS-CoV-2 ExoN-nsp10复合物结构为未来开发抗冠状病毒药物或减弱病毒毒力的策略提供了平台。
